verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26790451 from Dongguan Precision Housings to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318759 (dated 2026-10-05). Two lines for CMP-GAM-010 Statue "The Getaway" (die-cast, 18 cm): item 00020, 11,000 pcs, confirmed 2027-01-11; item 00010, 9,000 pcs, confirmed 2027-01-13. Both are at 88.38 CNY. Terms: FOB Yantian, NET30. The document has no handwriting, stamps or corrections.
red_flags: The document does not show the original ordered quantities, so confirmed quantities (total 20,000) cannot be checked against the PO from this document alone.
Items are listed out of order (00020 before 00010), and the higher item number has the earlier confirmed date (2027-01-11 vs 2027-01-13).
The same material (CMP-GAM-010) appears on two lines with identical unit price but different quantities and dates (split delivery).
No unit of measure is stated for the quantities, and no document date for the confirmation itself is given (only the PO date).
observations: Single-page, fully printed document; no handwriting, stamps, signatures or visible damage.
Header has Chinese title (订单确认书) alongside English.
Quantities use comma thousands separators (11,000 and 9,000).
